parent_success_order: parent candidate validates and calls the JOC writer
bit writer serializes the header, sequence, remaining fields, and payload into an output buffer
successful bit-writer return propagates to the parent writer
only then does the parent update its committed success counter

capture_boundaries.pre_serialization_stop: candidate inputs observable; writer status and counter-after NOT_OBSERVED
capture_boundaries.in_memory_sink: avoids file creation but still performs protected bit serialization
capture_boundaries.existing_file_sink: not output-free; prior captures wrote temporary encoded output before cleanup

remaining_user_choice_if_dynamic_success: Whether a future controlled sink may execute protected bit serialization while guaranteeing no file artifact; otherwise retain UNBOUND.
